areas.name: Sustainable cities

areas.name: Sport
areas.reason: Modernization of a multipurpose arena and a new public square with exercise equipment; indicators presented, but impact limited to the directly served area.

areas.name: Environment

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation

areas.name: Tourism
